gdprModal.title: Personal data protection
gdprModal.intro: When you register for an event we process your personal data in accordance with the GDPR. Below is the essential information on how we handle it.
gdprModal.controller_body: Buddhismus Diamantové cesty linie Karma Kagjü, Na Maninách 1288/17a, 170 00 Prague 7 – Holešovice, Czech Republic. Data-protection contact: info@bdc.cz (subject: data protection).
gdprModal.data_body: Participants' first and last name, e-mail address, the chosen centre, and details of your stay (arrival, departure, accommodation and meals).
gdprModal.purpose_body: We process the data to handle your registration and send you a confirmation — on the basis of contract performance (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR).
gdprModal.retention_body: We keep the data for as long as necessary to meet our legal and contractual obligations. Documents required for tax purposes are kept for approximately 10 years.
gdprModal.sharing_body: We do not share your data with third parties for commercial purposes. We pass it on only to the extent necessary to run the event, for example to the hosting centre.
gdprModal.rights_body: You have the right to access your data, to rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, portability, and the right to object (Art. 15–21 GDPR). Send your requests to info@bdc.cz.

schedule.derivedNote: Event days are derived from the date range; edit each day's meals in the Meals step.

tiers.participationTitle: Pricing tiers offered — participation and accommodation
tiers.participationNote: Tick the tiers a participant may choose from for participation and accommodation. The price list below is filled in for the ticked tiers only. The meal tier is entirely independent of this — it is set separately in the Meals step.
tiers.mealsNote: Tick the tiers a participant may choose from for meals. This does not depend on the participation and accommodation tier — each is chosen separately.

pricing.intro: Pricing rules are saved with the event.
pricing.childNote: Child categories are usually 0, but you can set your own daily and night rate – the calculation always follows the price list exactly. Arrival/departure discounts do not apply to children.

settings.mealDeadlineNote: After this time, meals can no longer be ordered for the event (participation and accommodation stay open). Optional — with no deadline (empty field) meal registration has no time limit. The time is Czech local time (SELČ/SEČ handled automatically).

meals.intro: The meal price list is set once for the whole event. On each day, exclude any meal that is not served — that fixes the event's first and last meal.
meals.noDates: First choose a start and end date in the Schedule step.
meals.priceListNote: These prices apply to the whole event — each day only decides whether a meal is served. Every category starts at the same price; lower it where a different one should apply (children, or the supported tier).
